Carmen (oncall): Heads up — we're seeing a sudden backpressure event at the ingress proxies in us-east-1 starting ~08:07 UTC, causing ~3% 503s for hosted text-generation endpoints and elevated p95 latencies. Declaring incident. Severity: S2. Status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2145006789 | Internal runbook: https://redwood.app/ops/incidents/2145006789

Infra Bot: alert: ingress-proxy-503-spike detected in us-east-1 at 08:07:12 UTC (anomaly score 8.2).

Ajay: I'm pulling proxy logs and stream sampling now. Querying ingress metrics: `sum(rate(proxy_503_total[1m])) by (cluster)` — will post findings in 2m.

Sarah: Noticed a recent rate-limiter config rollout at 07:58 UTC for: `edge-ingress-rate-limiter:v2`. Rolling it back to v1 as emergency mitigation. Command I ran: ```
curl -XPOST "https://infra-api.redwood.internal/configs/edge-ingress-rate-limiter/rollback" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $INFRA_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"target_version":"v1"}'
```

Carmen (oncall): Thanks @Sarah. I've enabled temporary emergency throttle on burst routing to protect downstream pods. Updating status page to "degraded" and noting affected endpoints.

deploy-bot: Deploy 2026-03-23T08:17:45Z — rollback edge-ingress-rate-limiter -> v1 — status: success.

Ajay: After rollback, p95 latency for /v1/generate decreased from 740ms -> 430ms, and 503 rate dropped from 3.1% -> 0.45% over the last 2m. Attaching top error traces and a short sampled log: `proxy: upstream timeout code=503 src=10.0.4.12:443`

Prodsupport: Live update sent to customers via status page and Slack customer channel (customers-team). Short note: "Degraded performance in us-east-1 resolved; mitigation applied, monitoring." Link to customer comms draft: https://redwood.app/internal/comms/2145006789

Evan: Good mitigation. Recommend capturing kernel metrics and the rate-limiter config diff for RCA. Can one of infra own the postmortem? I'll schedule a 1-hr RCA war room for 11:00 UTC.

Sarah: I'll own the infra section for the postmortem — will include the rollout timeline, config diff, and rollback command. Ajay can cover proxy telemetry.

Ajay: Adding short notes to incident doc: observed sudden surge in small burst traffic from a subset of tenants triggering new limiter behavior + incomplete throttling handshake with proxy. Follow-ups: stricter canary for rate-limiter rollout, automated rollback on 503 spike >1%.

Carmen (oncall): Current status: mitigated, partial customer impact resolved; continuing to monitor us-east-1 for 30m. Incident declared: mitigated. Resolution ETA: RCA / postmortem by EOD.

Prodsupport: Confirmed status page updated to "Operational (degraded earlier, mitigated)" and top customers notified.

Carmen (oncall): Closing thread here — will reopen if we see recurrence. Thanks everyone.

(Agent notes: incident doc link and status page above are canonical; follow-up owners: Sarah (infra), Ajay (telemetry), Prodsupport (customer comms), Evan (RCA lead).)
